_about: SHA-256 of the saved corrections of the linear repairs (kind 'weight': the repaired weight W of the edited module in its stored type; kind 'adapter': the factors Lf, Rf of the side path, float64). Bytes of each tensor in row-major order. The tensors themselves are not released (size; the re-editing rows re-run the editor that wrote the logs); a re-run of experiments/e2_prefix/code/job.py reproduces the files of the compensation and rollback rows, which can be compared with these hashes. Keys: working-tree log name (LOG_NAMES.json) -> record name.
